manufacturingNotes: All true interior openings must remain global voids, not white pieces or filled red regions.

knownDifficulty: A generic method may need manual review rather than a holed single-piece result.
manualJudgementNotes: The exact raster boundary is not frozen; global-void topology is. A valid automatic disposition uses multiple solid pieces to preserve the voids; otherwise it is MANUAL_REQUIRED.
